name: cairn
description: Cairn: a self-hostable memory system for AI assistants on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 directory: users, passkeys, sessions, projects, tokens, invites, quotas and usage. Migrations in migrations/ run on deploy.

OAUTH_KV.description: KV for the OAuth provider: registered clients, grants and (hashed) tokens.

VAULT.description: Durable Object class VaultDO: one SQLite database per project holding the notes, search index and revisions.

VECTORIZE.description: Vectorize index cairn-notes (1024 dimensions, cosine) for semantic search. Optional: without it search is keyword-only.

AI.description: Workers AI: embeddings, Jev (hints and re-ranking), image captions, weekly digests. Optional; capped per user by AI_DAILY_TOKENS.

FILES.description: R2 bucket cairn-files for attachments and images. Optional: without it uploads and email attachments are refused.

ASSETS.description: Static files in public/ (landing site, styles, browser bundles).

PUBLIC_URL.description: The URL people will use, e.g. https://cairn.example.com or your workers.dev URL. Passkeys and OAuth are bound to it: set it before anyone signs up.

APP_NAME.description: Name shown in the app and on the consent page.

OPEN_SIGNUP.description: "true" lets anyone sign up; "false" requires an invite link.

INBOUND_EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Address for email capture (needs an Email Routing rule sending it to this Worker). Remove to turn email capture off.

CAIRN_SETUP_TOKEN.description: Secret. Whoever presents it at sign-up or in Settings → Admin becomes an admin. Use a long random string.
